request.text: Close dry foley of a miniature sandstone nest folding then opening a pulley gate. 0-.9s: heavy stones scrape inward with solid rounded clacks. .9-1.6s: dressed blocks seat with gritty taps and wood fasteners click. 1.6-3.1s: a small wood pulley rolls, taut rope slides and a stone gate rises smoothly. 3.1-3.6s: counterweight settles with one deep clear stone knock and brief falling grit. Strong foreground. No music, voices, ambience or reverb.
